items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Last one I saw, I think, was Taps. And he doesn't play anymore.

ctx.x: They don't work if there is anybody.

Boy, that would be a good idea if some guy would come up with a good baritone playing. I know they could use it. You're right too. I haven't seen a baritone in a good while. Last one I saw, I think, was Taps. And he doesn't play anymore. Do you see much change in the brass bands? I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know.
I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know.
